title: Wari-Bateshwar Early Urban Centre
subtitle: An early archaeological horizon points to settlement, craft, and trade networks in the Bengal delta.
summary: Wari-Bateshwar in present-day Narsingdi is an archaeological complex often discussed as one of Bengal’s earliest urban or proto-urban centres. Excavated material has been used to connect the site with early settlement, craft production, coinage, and wider trade networks in the eastern delta.
heroTagline: An early archaeological horizon points to settlement, craft, and trade networks in the Bengal delta.
whyItMatters: The site widens the timeline of Bengal’s urban history beyond better-known classical and medieval centres, making early delta archaeology a necessary part of Bangladesh’s long historical arc.
